settings_scope: Repository settings.toml; actual server configuration must be supplied in --run-context

request_plan.scope: Counts RustXNG search calls, not provider requests or quota consumption. Server routing, retries, cache and other clients affect upstream traffic; review provider terms and quota before running.

diagnostic_case_origins: independently executed compiler snippet; topic references fixed before retrieval; no gold-page indexing or ranking tuning

operator_supplied_context.profile: api + explicit Qiita opt-in for bounded additive experiment only
operator_supplied_context.cache: fresh process at start; 600-second response cache; adjacent second repeat warm; language is part of each source request when supported; no cache bypass
operator_supplied_context.index: Existing index-docs and index-wikipedia loaded; excluded from this comparison by the explicit three-source baseline. The held-out references were not added to either index.
operator_supplied_context.language: default(auto) vs explicit ja; locale omitted; server ui.default_locale=en; deployment Japan
operator_supplied_context.period: pinpoint none, broad/fresh month; native publication-date filter for Exa
operator_supplied_context.billing: existing EXA_API_KEY kept only in process environment; explicitly selected paid API; no DeepSeek requests
operator_supplied_context.cold_warm_limitation: Adjacent repeats measure warm-cache behavior, not independent upstream resamples. Separate coverage runs restart the process.
